note: v495: Editing an expense no longer wipes its category or payment method. Anything recorded from the Statements screen — a prior-year refund, a reimbursement, a payment matched to an invoice — was saved with a category or method the edit form's dropdowns don't list, so simply opening it to fix a typo and saving blanked that field. The same applied when switching the Bank account on an expense, or after deleting a category older expenses still used. Those values are now kept and shown. Reimbursed expenses also show their badge in the desktop table, matching the phone.
